BrochureContent.Content:
We are delighted to bring to the market this substantial detached residence, which presents an exceptional opportunity to acquire a landmark property in one of Connemara's most scenic and sought-after locations, perfectly positioned in the heart of the picturesque village of Cornamona.

Occupying an impressive site in the centre of the village, the property combines generous residential accommodation with an extensive adjoining garage/workshop, offering enormous flexibility for residential, commercial or lifestyle use (subject to the necessary planning permissions).

Surrounded by the dramatic landscapes of Joyce Country and within moments of the shores of Lough Corrib, this is a rare opportunity to enjoy village living while embracing everything the West of Ireland has to offer.

The property offers spacious accommodation extending to approximately 161 sq.m. (1,739 sq.ft.), thoughtfully arranged over two floors. The rooms are bright and airy throughout, with some traditional features, including open fireplaces in each of the four upstairs bedrooms. There is also a large, recently renovated shower room upstairs. On the ground floor, one enters into a hall/foyer. To the left is a well proportioned room which could be utilised as a fifth bedroom, or a convenient home office space. Right off the porch is a large dining/living space and to towards the rear is a newly renovated kitchen. The ground floor also has a large separtate sitting room with solid fuel stove. Finally, there is a groundfloor shower room.

A standout feature of the property is the substantial adjoining garage extending to approximately 140 sq.m. (1,504 sq.ft.). With its impressive sale and direct access from the roadside, the space offers exceiptional versatility and potential. Properties offering this combination of residential accommodation and such significant ancillary space are seldom available.

The property is serviced by mains water and there is an onsite septic tank.

Cornamona is a picturesque village on the shores of Lough Corrib in County Galway, offering a peaceful rural lifestyle with essential local amenities including a primary school, shops, cafés, pubs, and community facilities. The village is surrounded by stunning scenery and outdoor recreation. Nearby towns include Headford (approx. 20 minutes), Oughterard (approx. 25 minutes), and Clifden (approx. 1 hour), while Galway City is just under an hour away, providing easy access to a wide range of shopping, dining, education, and transport links.

Contact our office today to arrange a private viewing.
